about: A template presents text: no assignment, capture, func, include and the rest (chapter 5 § 5.2.1). The plan's prompt writes the draft. Invalid: it captures the draft first. Valid: it writes it.
sentences: Node 'plan' uses capture at line 3; templates present text and may not use assignment, capture, func, include, import, with, wrap, while, break, continue, case, tablerow or arithmetic.
